The loop disassembles as: d2 = 1, 'move.w d5,d0; and.w d2,d0' selects 0x80a72e[d3] (analog_sensor_override_values) as the filtered value, add.w d2,d2 per channel, and at d3 = 16 d2 = 1 again with d5 = word 6; it ends at 0x80a4d0 = 25 channels. So bit n = channel n. In CM550's own e2m the OD record with mask 1 << n has the stem of channel n's block 1003 record for all 16 (checked from the CA / HE / LE records). The word is tested and never written, so a bitfield suits it (7 named tests against one whole-word load). CM848's word 5 is a different set, so the type is CM550's own.
